title: Senior Accountant II
description:
Overview

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

We are currently seeking a Senior Accounting Associate to join one of our client teams. Our Sr. Accounting Associate performs a variety of professional level accounting duties involved in preparing, maintaining, analyzing, verifying, and reconciling moderately complex financial transactions, statements, records, and reports. You will maintain the accuracy of the ledgers and financial systems; assist in the preparation of assigned client deliverables and period close activities.

What this job involves

  • Compile, prepare, and review month-end accruals. Post JE in accordance with ASC606 guidelines. Complete monthly accrual reconciliation to ensure client financials tie to JLL E1 ledger.
  • Responsible for the timely and accurate recognition of revenue in compliance with contract terms and internal corporate guidelines. Generate monthly fee invoices in PeopleSoft. Provide commentary on aging invoices. Research and take action on past due items.
  • Ensure that balance sheet reconciliations are completed in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Cross-collaborate with internal and external teams to ensure client and corporate business needs are met.
  • Assist in maintaining an accurate pipeline (work in process) by obtaining transaction details and accurately updating or inputting specific information. Prepare and post reclass JE as needed.
  • Support AP as needed to ensure timely payments and outstanding issues are resolved.
  • Assist in year-end close activities to ensure compliance with contract deliverables and meet finance KPI.
  • Oversee cash activity by montoring bank account deposits, issuing payments, maintaining funding log, and recording cash entries.
  • Manage Pcard process, including reviewing and closing transactions, updating approval matrix, and facilitating new card setup.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required
  • 3-5 years of accounting experience, some real estate experience preferred
  • Advanced accounting and analytical skills
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other spreadsheet applications required; experience with real estate accounting software a plus (JDE, MRI, Skyline, and/or Timberline) JD Edwards E1 knowledge a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated consistency in values, principles and work ethic
  • Ability to work independently and within a team to build relationships and interact effectively with business partners
  • Ability to multi-task, work successfully under pressure, and effectively prioritize and manage time and workload to meet client needs
  • Willingness to take on new challenges, responsibilities, and assignments
  • Understanding of and commitment to client services
  • A desire to work within a diverse, collaborative, and driven professional environment
  • This is a virtual position; however, the ideal candidate will be located within driving distance to our Westmont office and be willing to participate in occasional on-site team meetings, trainings, etc.

Estimated compensation

85,000.00 – 95,000.00 USD per year

This range is an estimate and actual compensation may differ. Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location

Remote – Chicago, IL

How to apply

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Benefits

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits may include:

  • 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care
  • Paid parental leave at 100% of salary
  • Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

JLL Privacy Notice: Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading global provider of real estate and investment management services. We take our responsibility to protect the personal information provided to us seriously. Generally the personal information we collect from you are for the purposes of processing in connection with JLL’s recruitment process. We endeavour to keep your personal information secure with appropriate level of security and keep for as long as we need it for legitimate business or legal reasons. We will then delete it safely and securely. For more information about how JLL processes your personal data, please view our Candidate Privacy Statement. For additional details please see our career site pages for each country. For candidates in the United States, please see a full copy of our Equal Employment Opportunity policy here. Please direct any other general recruiting inquiries to our Contact Us page. This job posting includes various regional notices and disclosures as applicable by law.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
Job Description
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Job Description
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.
Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!
Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!
Responsibilities and assignments
O Cientista de Dados aplica uma sólida expertise em intelicência artificial por meio do uso de machine learning, data mining e recuperação de informações para desenhar, criar protótipos e desenvolver mecanismos e serviços de advanced analytics. O cientista de dados colabora com os parceiros de negócios para definição do problema técnico e a hipótese a ser testada: desenvolve modelos analíticos eficientes e precisos que imitam as decisões de negócios e as incorporam a produtos ou ferramentas de dados analíticos com o suporte de uma equipe multifuncional.
O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Colaborar com parceiros de negócios para desenvolver novas formas de atingir os objetivos utilizando técnions e ferramentas de ponta.
  • Comunicar eficazmente a abordagem de analytios e como ela atenderá e abordará os objetivos aos parceiros de negócio
  • Educar sobre o valor da tomada de decisão basesda em dados, focando no "como e por que" da rezolução de problemas
  • Liderar abordagens analiticas, integrando o trabalho a aplicativos e ferramentas com engenheiros de dedos, lideres de negócios. analistas e desenvolvedores.
  • Criar modelos repetiveis, interpretáveis, dinámicos e escalonáveis que s perfeitamente incorporados aos produtos de dados analiticos
  • Projetar recursos usando sua perspicácia nos negócios para encontrar novas formas combiner diferentes fontes de dedos internas e externas lidentificar e desenvolver processos, estrutures, ferramentas, métodos e pedrões
  • Colaborar, fornecer coaching e aprender com uma equipe crescente de cientistas de dados experientes.
  • Manter-se conectado com fontes externas de ideias por meio de conferências e projetos da comunidade
Requirements And Qualifications
O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:
Requisitos essenciais:
  • Bacharelado obrigatório, Mestrado ou PhD desejável
  • Bacharelado em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística + 5 anos de experiência requerido ou graduação em disciplina quantitativa e conjunto de habilidades de Ciência de Dados demonstrado, e'me de mais 2 anos de experiência profissional.
  • Deve ter proficiência em Python ou R trabalhando com DataFrames
  • Deve ter proficiência na criação de consultas complexas de SQL
  • Deve ter proficiência com Machine Learning para solucionar problemas de clustering, detecção de anomalias, simulação e otimização em conjuntos de dados em larga escala
  • Deve ter capacidade comprovada para fundir e transformar conjuntos de dados internos e externos distintos para criar novos recursos
  • Experiência com tecnologias de Big Data desejada - Hadoop, Spark, H2O.ai, plataformas de inteligência artificial em nuvem, conteinerização
  • Experiência no suporte à implementação, monitoramento, manutenção e mentoria dos modelos desejados
  • Experiência preferencial com ferramentas de visualização de dados - Tableau, R shiny
Additional information
O que te oferecemos:
 Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;
Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;
Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;
Mentoring;
Auxílio Creche;
Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;
Assistência Médica;
Assistência Odontológica;
Clube de vantagens e descontos nos melhores estabelecimentos;
Clube de viagens;
Convênio para Pet;
e muito mais...

  • Fit Cultural
  • Bate papo com Gente & Cultura
  • Bate papo com Gestão
  • Carta proposta
  • Hiring
Stefanini: Acreditar para Cocriar
Na Stefanini, a inovação não é apenas uma meta; é uma jornada que trilhamos juntos, onde a colaboração se torna a essência da transformação. Com 37 anos de história e uma presença global em mais de 40 países, contamos com uma equipe de 38 mil talentos apaixonados, prontos para transformar desafios em oportunidades por meio da tecnologia.
Acreditamos que cada projeto é uma oportunidade e que, juntos, podemos moldar um futuro mais ágil, eficiente e conectado. Nossa missão vai além de oferecer soluções: buscamos cocriar com nossos clientes, integrando inteligência artificial e tecnologias emergentes para revolucionar o cotidiano das empresas.
Aqui, cada voz conta e cada ideia tem o poder de impactar. Valorizamos a humildade, o respeito, o comprometimento e a coragem, construindo uma cultura onde a inovação floresce. Aqui, liderar é dar o exemplo, e é por isso que inspiramos um ambiente dinâmico onde tecnologia e talento se complementam.
Se você sonha grande, tem coragem de desafiar o convencional e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que acredita no poder da cocriação, junte-se a nós! Vamos, juntos, acreditar e cocriar um futuro brilhante, onde cada passo representa uma nova conquista!

About Bonsai
Bonsai is the all-in-one platform helping agencies, consultancies, and professional service firms run and scale their operations. From lean 5-person studios to 100-person teams, thousands of businesses around the world rely on Bonsai to streamline their workflows and manage everything from proposals and contracts to time tracking, invoicing, finances, and even banking.

About Bonsai
Bonsai is the all-in-one platform helping agencies, consultancies, and professional service firms run and scale their operations. From lean 5-person studios to 100-person teams, thousands of businesses around the world rely on Bonsai to streamline their workflows and manage everything from proposals and contracts to time tracking, invoicing, finances, and even banking.
As the way we work evolves, so do the needs of modern service businesses. Admin and operations can quickly become a bottleneck to growth—Bonsai removes that friction, so teams can stay focused on delivering great work, not managing overhead.
We're profitable, growing fast, and backed by world-class investors including Y Combinator, Matrix Partners, and Index Ventures.
About The Role
Our customers are at the center of what we do and we're always trying to find better ways to serve them. As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for our users, ensuring they receive timely, friendly, and effective assistance. Your role will be to support small businesses in navigating the Bonsai platform, troubleshooting issues, and providing clear, helpful guidance.
You'll work closely with our Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for users, improve the customer experience, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of Bonsai's platform. Whether answering questions, troubleshooting problems, or sharing product insights, your goal is to empower customers and ensure they get the most out of Bonsai.
This role is perfect for someone who loves helping people, has strong problem-solving skills, and enjoys working in a fast-paced, scrappy environment.
Responsibilities

  • Customer Support: Provide fast, friendly, and knowledgeable support via email and live chat
  • Customer Advocacy: Gather feedback from users and collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform
  • Help Center & Documentation: Contribute to support articles, FAQs, and other resources to empower customers with self-service options
  • Process Improvement: Identify areas to enhance our support workflows and ensure we provide an outstanding customer experience
Requirements
  • 6+ months of experience in customer support, customer success, or a similar role, ideally within SaaS
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a friendly and professional tone
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while staying highly responsive and engaged
  • Familiarity with support tools like Intercom, Zendesk, or similar platforms
  • A proactive mindset—you anticipate issues before they arise and take initiative to solve them
  • Experience with Excel/Google Sheets is a plus
Benefits
  • Remote work set-up
  • All-expenses-paid team retreats—our last retreat was in Lisbon
  • The opportunity to work with a passionate, global team and make a real impact on small businesses

Direct message the job poster from Tata Consultancy Services

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Python + React JS Developer,Remote mode in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

o ReactJS and TypeScript

o Python

o Serverless back-end development (e.g., AWS Lambda).

o Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

o Database Administration - Proficient in both SQL and NoSQL databases, including optimization and diagnostics.(e.g. AWS Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB)

o AWS DynamoDB

o AWS RDS

o SnowFlake

o AWS CloudFront

o AWS S3

o AWS Glue

o PySpark

o Elastic Search (OpenSearch is a plus)

o AWS Lambda

o AWS API Gateway

o JupiterNotes

o Experience with Git, CDK, CI/CD pipelines, and debugging tools.

Familiarity with front-end build tools like Webpack or Vite..

The Full Stack Developer for the Text Sentinel application will play a crucial role in maintaining, enhancing, and scaling the system's architecture and user interface. This role demands expertise in both front-end and back-end development, with a strong focus on AWS serverless solutions and ReactJS for the UI.Front-End Development:

o Integrate front-end components with back-end APIs and AWS services.

o Optimize the UI for performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

2. Back-End Development:

o Develop serverless back-end logic using AWS Lambda functions in Python.

o Design and implement RESTful APIs with AWS API Gateway to support front-end and third-party integrations.

o Proficient in both SQL and NoSQL databases, including management, optimization and diagnostics.(e.g. AWS Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB)

3. AWS Service Management:

o Configure and deploy UI using AWS CloudFront for secure and efficient content delivery.

o Work with AWS S3 for static asset management and storage solutions.

o Collaborate on the integration of beneficial AWS services like SNS, SES,, SageMaker, and AWS Bedrock for AI-driven capabilities.

4. Testing and Debugging:

o Write and maintain unit tests for front-end and back-end components.

o Debug and resolve production issues to ensure system reliability.

5. Operations:

o Proven ability to troubleshoot data issues, including missing or inconsistent records, query failures, and performance degradation.

o Ability to investigate data discrepancies across systems (e.g., source vs target, API vs DB) using joins, comparisons, and reconciliation techniques.

o Experience with monitoring and alerting on data health (e.g., volume checks, freshness, pipeline success rates).

o Comfortable using scripting or automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash) to support diagnostics and repetitive troubleshooting tasks.

o Full ownership of identifying, investigating, and resolving data-related issues, including root cause analysis, query optimization, and data integrity checks, with minimal dependency on internal teams and occasional coordination with third-party providers if required.

o Work closely with DevOps, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.

o Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and system design discussions.

Python, React , SQL

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

Health insurance

Life insurance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Reimbursement of Certifications

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior HR Generalist - Americas
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Senior HR Generalist - Americas role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Senior HR Generalist - Americas role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Senior HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region
The role entails

  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
  • Interact closely with the Americas HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions
  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive a high performing team
  • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice to have skills
  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Consultor(a) de vendas
description:
Overview

Quer fazer parte da MAIOR joalheria do mundo?! Então, essa vaga é para você. Estamos com uma vaga de Consultor(a) de Vendas aberta! Este profissional irá atuar em nosso kiosk no Norte Shopping Rio de Janeiro - RJ.

Sobre a Pandora

A Joalheria que Transforma Histórias em Joias! Com sede em Copenhague, Dinamarca, a Pandora fabrica suas deslumbrantes joias em três instalações de artesanato na Tailândia, onde mestres artesãos dedicam-se a criar cada peça com perfeição, se destacando como a maior joalheria do mundo, famosa por seus icônicos braceletes e charms que permitem que você conte sua própria história. Além disso, suas coleções incluem anéis, brincos e colares, todos com designs exclusivos e elaborados à mão, utilizando apenas materiais de altíssima qualidade.

Inovadora e Sustentável

A Pandora é pioneira no setor, sendo a primeira joalheria do mundo a utilizar produtos 100% reciclados. Com um compromisso firme com a sustentabilidade, cada peça não é apenas uma joia, mas uma celebração do estilo e da consciência ambiental.

Valores

Na PANDORA, somos guiados por quatro valores: We Dream (Sonhamos), We Dare (Ousamos), We Care (Cuidamos) e We Deliver (Entregamos). We Dream: somos visionários e vamos além do óbvio. We Dare: perseguir ambições ousadas com coragem e rapidez. We Care: nos preocupamos profundamente uns com os outros, com nossos clientes e com o planeta que todos compartilhamos. Todos os dias nos esforçamos para ser um local de trabalho gratificante, onde cada um de nós pode prosperar e contribuir, onde os talentos podem crescer e cumprimos nossas promessas a colegas, clientes e parceiros — We Deliver (entregamos).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o atendimento personalizado aos clientes da marca;
  • Atendimento ao cliente na pós-venda;
  • Criar uma base de clientes fidelizados;
  • Gestão e organização de estoque, operação do sistema, devoluções e trocas;
  • Abastecer a loja e repor peças quando não estão disponíveis na seção;
  • Manter a organização, montagem e limpeza da vitrine;
  • Participar dos treinamentos internos, sobre os produtos de luxo feito à mão para se tornar um especialista em produtos PANDORA;
  • Seguir as diretrizes da empresa, cumprindo todas as políticas e procedimentos, a fim de manter o padrão internacional de nossas lojas;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente e em vendas;
  • Comunicação clara e receptiva, capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes com constantes mudanças;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar na escala 6x1.

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Convênio farmácia;
  • Parceria com Gympass;
  • Crédito cartão flash;
  • Desconto em produtos Pandora;
  • Empréstimo consignado;
  • Parceria com descontos para seguros;
  • Programa de bônus por indicação de talentos;
  • Folga aniversário;
  • Curso de inglês e espanhol com desconto exclusivo Open English;
  • Plano de carreira.

Quem Somos Nós?


Hiwell é a principal plataforma de terapia online na Turquia, Portugal e Grécia — conectando mais de 850.000 clientes a uma rede confiável de mais de 1.500 psicólogos. Nossa missão é simples : ajudar as pessoas a se entenderem melhor, se sentirem melhor e viverem de forma mais positiva.


Agora, estamos entusiasmados em expandir nossos serviços e introduzir o suporte nutricional online em nossa plataforma!


Como Trabalhamos


Por meio do nosso aplicativo móvel de fácil utilização, os clientes agora podem acessar facilmente serviços profissionais de nutrição — a qualquer hora, em qualquer lugar. Estamos construindo uma equipe de nutricionistas altamente qualificados, comprometidos em fornecer um atendimento personalizado e de alta qualidade.


A Hiwell é uma plataforma 100% remota, o que significa que você pode trabalhar de qualquer cidade ou país, no seu próprio ritmo e horário.


O Que Estamos Procurando


Estamos em busca de profissionais dedicados, experientes e éticos, que sejam apaixonados por ajudar os outros. Os candidatos ideais atenderão aos seguintes requisitos :



  • Ter diploma de graduação na área de nutrição

  • Ser registrado no CRN (Conselho Regional de Nutricionistas)

  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente e acompanhamento online

  • Proficiência em métodos nutricionais atuais e ferramentas digitais

  • Comprometimento com a ética profissional e a confidencialidade do cliente


Se você está pronto para ajudar a moldar o futuro do cuidado nutricional online e atende às qualificações acima, adoraríamos ouvir você!

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the \'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,\' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects , including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance .

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model .
  • Proven track record in data migration projects , including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar .
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing .
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE: Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

title: Neuroscience Sales Specialist - Birmingham, AL
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking talent near: Birmingham, AL; Prattville, AL; Selma, AL

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1 year of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist : Minimum 5 years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.
  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.
  • Must comply with vaccination requirements for HCP office access, long-term care facilities, and medical conferences.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs.

Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and, depending on territory needs, within reasonable proximity to a major airport. Requires eligibility to drive a company vehicle and ability to travel independently by air. Travel may be up to 80% of the time, including occasional after-hours work based on business needs.

description:

Join to apply for the Lead Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
The Canonical Kernel Team is seeking exceptionally talented technology experts and industry veterans with a proven track record in operating systems kernel development or low level system engineering to take the lead in the architecture, implementation, and ongoing delivery of the following (but not limited to) aspects of the Ubuntu Linux kernel:

  • Driving engagements for key Silicon and Cloud partners to provide optimal solutions for their platforms
  • Leading the mitigation of common vulnerabilities and exposures for Ubuntu Linux as well as driving active hardening in the kernel
  • Architecting enhancements to performance and correctness to make Ubuntu Linux the most reliable and highest performing Linux kernel available today
  • Streamlining the packaging and distribution of particularly troublesome third-party components for optimal experience by end users
  • Developing new means to deliver Ubuntu Linux at scale to the strict quality standards and delivery schedules expected by end users
While not a formal managerial role, the successful candidate will possess strong people skills and natural ability to lead engineers within the team, as well as working with other external teams to coordinate adoption and delivery.
We are looking for individuals with not only an incredibly deep technical background in operating system kernels and distributions, but also a strong flair for leadership and taking initiative to drive ideas and the associated delivery teams to completion.
While we hesitate to put a specific number of years of experience as a requirement for an applicant as that does not take into account relative ability or circumstances, for a comparative guideline we would be seeking candidates with the demonstrated technical equivalent of 15+ years of industry experience.
Location: We have home-based lead kernel engineer roles in every timezone, although the individual aspects as listed above may be linked to a specific geographic region.
What the role entails
  • Set the technical direction and lead the delivery of a team of junior and mid-career engineers for a key aspect of Ubuntu Linux
  • Work closely with management within and outside the team to track and coordinate initiatives to delivery
  • Collaborate daily with other senior technical leadership on the Kernel Team on how best to ensure Ubuntu stays at the pinnacle of Linux distributions
What we are looking for in you
  • Well-organised and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Expert understanding of the C programming language
  • Demonstrated expertise working in a *nix-based operating system kernel and distribution. While direct Linux experience would be ideal, it is not required.
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Powerful grasp of the capabilities and nuances of the git version control system
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Ability to travel internationally at least twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length
Nice-to-have skills
  • Strong background in RTOS and real-time performance analysis
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience with Rust, ideally as it pertains to the Linux kernel
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Potencializamos a evolução: Transformamos ideias em realidade em uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora. Fazer parte deste time, significa aprender, criar e evoluir.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\'t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn\'t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

The Humane League (THL) is a global nonprofit ending the abuse of animals raised for food. THL fosters a high-energy culture of teamwork and mission-driven problem solving, and we have earned recognition as Top Charity from Animal Charity Evaluators for all of their rating periods. Over the past few years, we’ve grown to a staff of 100+ talented individuals dispersed across the country and around the world. At THL, how animals are treated in the food system is at the forefront of our everyday work. As such, many of our staff are vegan by personal choice, and all of our THL-hosted events offer fully vegan menus. We welcome all mission-aligned candidates to apply, no matter where you are in your journey to end the abuse of animals raised for food.
The Role
The Open Wing Alliance (OWA), a program of The Humane League, is a global coalition of approximately 90 animal protection organizations across 70+ countries united in a common goal: to end the abuse of chickens worldwide. For the past several years, we have focused our efforts on eliminating battery cages by securing cage-free policies from major retailers, restaurants, and manufacturers. OWA groups share tactics and resources to secure as many wins for animals as possible, specializing in institutional campaigning that can be tailored to our members’ unique circumstances and challenges.
As the OWA Latin America Corporate Strategy Lead, you will serve as a key subject matter expert on corporate campaigning and corporate outreach for the OWA in Latin America. You’ll be responsible for building relationships with OWA member groups and providing advice, coaching, and training in order to develop campaign knowledge and skills across the animal protection movement in the region. We want you because you are an experienced campaigner and strategic thinker with excellent interpersonal skills. You are excited about collaborating with organizations across Latin America to maximize impact for animals, and you have a deep determination to remove the worst forms of animal suffering from companies’ supply chains. This position reports to the Sr. OWA Latin America Manager.
This is a full-time, remote position. This position requires domestic and international travel, equivalent to 6-10 trips per year, and requires a valid, up-to-date passport. To enable collaboration with other global team members, you may be required to work occasional hours outside of 9am - 5pm, depending on your time zone. More details can be provided at the interview stage.
Essential Job Duties

  • Provide OWA member groups in Latin America with strategic guidance and direction for regional corporate campaign strategies, and collaborate with groups to troubleshoot issues.
  • Co-create strategies with OWA groups and serve as a coach, building their independence over time. Support groups in adapting campaign tactics to different local and regional contexts in order to secure cage-free commitments from companies.
  • Lead in-person and virtual trainings for OWA groups on corporate campaigning and corporate outreach.
  • Develop and implement personalized support plans and trainings for OWA groups.
  • Build strong relationships and trust with OWA groups, alongside a reputation as a sharp strategic thinker and strategist.
  • Develop resources and training materials in order to build resilience, empowerment, and autonomy in the OWA.
In addition to the above essential job duties, other duties may be assigned as business needs arise. These may include non-essential, marginal job duties.
Ideal Profile
  • You have previous experience with corporate pressure campaigns and/or corporate negotiations. Experience developing campaign strategy as well as carrying out specific functions related to a campaign's success
  • You have strong strategic thinking and problem solving skills, and are proactive, take initiative, and adaptable
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills and are able to collaborate well with others

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us

About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Overview

Senior Sales Consultant for Small Legal

Founded in 2003, ProSites now helps over 20,000 professionals with their online marketing needs. The company is comprised of four brands, all of which provide website design and online marketing solutions to professional markets. We have over 300 team members across 4 offices and are part of the Rock Family of Companies (Rockbridge Growth Equity LLC). ProSites, Inc. has been recognized on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for 2012, voted #1 in website design and services, and on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for six years. Since 2004, ProSites has served professionals across North America, including in the fields of Dental, Legal, Animal Health, and Accounting. Our marketing solutions include Website Design, SEO, PPC, Social Media, Content Marketing and Practice Solution Software.

ProSites is adding to our team of Digital Marketing, Sales Consultants. We are seeking a few driven individuals to join our sales team in the areas of Hunting/Prospecting/New Business Development.

Responsibilities

Basic Functions

The Senior Sales Consultant is responsible for outbound prospecting calls and selling ProSites portfolio of website design and internet marketing solutions, while meeting or exceeding sales quotas. Successful candidates will have previous experience as a top producer making outbound prospecting calls, establishing and maintaining client relationships, identifying potential new clients and opportunities, managing a sales funnel and closing sales with decision makers.

Essential Applicant Attributes

  • Proven track record of being a top producing sales consultant
  • "Hunter" mentality
  • Persistent and able to handle rejection
  • Thrive on success with a positive attitude
  • Ability to adapt to change
  • Experience in a competitive fast-paced sales environment
  • Excellent social skills and desire to excel
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills
  • High level of comfort with internet technology
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Motivated to be part of a fast-moving, entrepreneurial team
  • Ability to provide clear written documentation using MS Office and CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, MS Dynamics, NetSuite)
  • Comfortable serving and interacting with business owners in Dental, Veterinary, Accounting or Legal practices
  • Balance a customer service approach with a sales approach
  • Long-term career focus; many sales consultants have been here a decade or longer
  • Driven to succeed in a high commission environment
  • Persistent and able to handle objections professionally
  • Thrives in a self-directed, self-driven sales environment
  • Comfortable working remotely
  • Regular and reliable attendance is required as this is a full-time position

Key Skills, Abilities, and Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of technology-based sales experience in a direct account executive or indirect sales support role
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial attitude and growth mindset
  • Ability to provide clear and comprehensive written documentation using MS Office
  • Ability to provide high quality communication that is respectful and professional
  • Passion for building relationships, understanding business and serving others
  • Experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce.com, HubSpot, MS Dynamics, NetSuite)

  • Coachability and willingness to learn from peers
  • Inquisitive approach to find answers for clients
  • Ability to work with diverse personalities and strong time management
  • Ability to build a consistent new business revenue pipeline

  • Focused on long-term career in sales

Physical/Mental Requirements for the Job

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Atuar como o parceiro estratégico e conselheiro de confiança (trusted advisor) dos nossos clientes, garantindo que eles obtenham o máximo de valor de negócio das soluções Sensedia. A missão do CSM é orquestrar a jornada do cliente de ponta a ponta, impulsionando a adoção, a satisfação e o crescimento para garantir a renovação e maximizar o Net Dollar Retention (NDR).

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Construir e manter um relacionamento profundo com os clientes, entendendo seus objetivos de negócio, KPIs e desafios para desenvolver um plano de sucesso de longo prazo.
  • Capacitação e Evangelismo: Realizar workshops técnicos, demonstrações e sessões de capacitação para as equipes do cliente, garantindo que eles tenham autonomia e conhecimento para utilizar as soluções da melhor forma.
  • Condução de Ritos de Valor: Liderar reuniões executivas de negócios (QBRs), apresentando análises de performance, o ROI alcançado e o alinhamento estratégico para o futuro.
  • Monitoramento e Ação Proativa: Monitorar continuamente a saúde da conta através de dados e métricas (Health Score, NPS, uso de produto), identificando riscos e oportunidades de forma proativa.
  • Desenhar e Apresentar Soluções: Conduzir sessões de discovery técnico com os clientes para entender seus desafios de negócio e desenhar soluções funcionais utilizando as capabilities da plataforma Sensedia.
  • Orquestração de Soluções: Atuar como a voz do cliente dentro da Sensedia, mobilizando e colaborando com os times de Produto, Suporte e Vendas para orquestrar a resolução de desafios e garantir que os esforços internos estejam alinhados às prioridades do cliente.
  • Motor de Crescimento: Identificar, qualificar e nutrir oportunidades de expansão (upsell/cross-sell), trabalhando em estreita parceria com o time de Vendas para converter essas oportunidades em novas receitas.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência Comprovada: Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management ou Gerenciamento de Contas em empresas de tecnologia (preferencialmente SaaS ou PaaS).
  • Fluência Técnica Funcional: Boa compreensão de conceitos de APIs e integrações de sistemas, conhecimento geral do design de APIs com Open API Specification / Swagger e modelos de segurança, noções básicas de arquitetura de software (microservices x monolithic), visão de Negócio e Dados: Familiaridade com as principais métricas de CS (NPS, Churn, NDR, Health Score) e capacidade de conectar soluções tecnológicas a resultados de negócio.
  • Comunicação e Didática Excepcionais: Habilidade de apresentar, negociar e se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com diferentes públicos, do técnico ao executivo, e de conduzir workshops de capacitação.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência na gestão de contas Enterprise complexas.
  • Vivência na identificação e qualificação de oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Conhecimento no ecossistema Open Finance Brasil.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de integrações.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\u2019t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You wouldn\u2019t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Nice-to-haves

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and an annual fitness reimbursement.
  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.
  • Professional Growth: Up to $1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

We help over 75,000 real people every month take control of their health with clean, powerful supplements—no fillers, no fakes, no celebrity nonsense.

Now we’re building the most effective marketing team in the industry—starting with you.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re hiring a Meta Ads Manager who can take full control of our Facebook and Instagram ad channels—replacing agency and outperforming them in 60 days.

This role is yours to own. You’ll run it, scale it, and build a machine around it.

We want someone who’s driven by mission, not just money.

If you want to be just another media buyer, this isn’t for you.

If you want to help people, move fast, and finally work on something real—you’ll thrive here.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take over our Meta ad account (currently spending £400K/month)
  • Come up with 95% of the ad angles, hooks, and campaigns (Founder will send you some things to turn into ads)
  • Build and test landing pages that actually convert
  • Use our 33K+ reviews, customer stories, and product results to fuel your creative
  • Turn the founder’s raw ideas, notes, or videos into full ads (when provided)
  • Build your own lean team as needed (e.g., video editor, outsourced image creation, etc.) — but only when it’s worth the money. We run lean, cut dead wood fast, and only hire when absolutely necessary so you should have the skills to start doing the above and then hire.
  • Hit and maintain ROAS targets unless testing a branding initiative
  • Ask for what you need—tools, creators, budget. You’ll have our backing most of the time.

WHAT YOU WON’T DO

  • You won’t wait for us to tell you what to test
  • You won’t be buried in meetings
  • You won’t be forced to work on fake, low-quality products
  • You won’t be chasing bonuses—we expect high performance as standard
  • You won’t be treated like a cog in a machine

WHO YOU ARE

  • You’ve scaled Meta ad accounts spending £100K+/month and know what you’re doing
  • You think like a direct-response marketer and live inside customer psychology
  • You know how to write or brief scroll-stopping ads
  • You’re not afraid to take ownership and lead
  • Most of all—you want to build something real that helps people

COMPENSATION

  • Compensation based on experience – we’re open to finding the right fit. We pay well, but we don’t pay for fluff. If you’ve got the skills, we’ll make it work
  • Full-time and fully remote (some in-person meetings if nearby)
  • 28 days paid annual leave
  • No performance bonus—we don’t bribe people to care.
  • Long-term loyalty and impact will be rewarded in more meaningful ways

WHY THIS MATTERS

If you knock this out of the park, we’ll give you more. More traffic sources. More responsibility. More opportunity.

Our long-term goal is to scale to £10 million/month in ad spend—across Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, X, direct mail, and more. That’s the level we’re building for.

There are some manufacturing constraints we need to solve first, but once we do, we’ll need leaders who can handle massive growth.

Show us you’re the one—and you’ll grow with us.

You’ll be replacing a bloated agency that’s spending big and underdelivering.

You’ll be part of a team that tells the truth, helps people feel better, and fights back against the garbage being pushed by Big Pharma and mainstream wellness brands.

If that excites you—you might be one of us.
