Who We Are


Curtiss-Wright Engineered Pump Division (EPD) and its predecessor companies have been providing naval and maritime technological expertise since 1847. EPD\'s pumps go to the heart of the systems that enable the Navy\'s ships and submarines to protect our nation. EPD is the leading supplier of mission-critical pumps for the U.S. Navy\'s Ford & Nimitz Class aircraft carriers and Virginia Class submarines, as well as the Navy\'s next-generation Columbia Class submarine. EPD also supports the entire naval fleet with various innovative pumping solutions such as composite pumps and parts, and provides complete overhaul, upgrade and field service capabilities.

  • Excellent relationship management, customer service and communication skills in a variety of forms (written, live chat, conference calls).
  • Ability to work independently with little direct supervision and as a part of a team.

  • Ability to remain calm, composed and articulate when dealing with tough customer situations.

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting Kernel level security solutions.
  • Experience supporting hybrid environments.
  • Experience supporting security applications such as AV, VPN, Firewall, proxy.
  • Linux troubleshooting experience a plus.
  • Experience with Splunk.
  • Experience with troubleshooting Windows and Mac.

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatchedexpertiseand patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding$2 billion. Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. OVERVIEW:
The Display Strategist is a seasoned, data-driven professional responsible for developing and executing strategic programmatic advertising initiatives within the retail media landscape. This role is essential in designing and scaling high-performance programmatic strategies, creating full-funnel commerce solutions, and delivering measurable results for clients. The Display Strategist will utilize expertise in platforms such as Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, advanced measurement tools, and the broader retail media ecosystem to deliver innovative solutions aligned with clients' business objectives. As a key partner to clients, internal teams, and retail media platforms, this position plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of programmatic advertising within the organization.
REQUIREMENTS:

  • 4-5 years of experience in programmatic advertising, including 2-3 years managing programmatic retail media (onsite or offsite) across the full campaign life cycle (strategy and activation).
  • 2+ years in a client-facing role, with a preference for experience managing small to medium-sized brands.
  • Strong understanding of Demand Side Platforms (DSPs), including retailer-native (Amazon DSP, Walmart) and non-retailer specific platforms (The Trade Desk, Criteo Commerce Max) for setup and optimization.
  • Proven experience managing a variety of programmatic channels (Display, Video - STV/OTT, Audio, Native, DOOH) and a strategic understanding of deploying these channels to achieve client KPIs.
  • Ability to connect full-funnel marketing efforts (search and display) to retailer-specific sales goals and performance.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated capacity for working autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a proven track record of presenting and selling ideas clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and thrive under tight deadlines.
  • A strong desire to work in a fast-paced, evolving industry that presents new challenges and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinker with adaptability and the ability to analyze data to identify opportunities and optimize results.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Play a key role within a rapidly growing programmatic advertising team, refining processes and structures to support continued success.
  • Lead the development, execution, and optimization of programmatic display and video campaigns on platforms like Amazon DSP and The Trade Desk.
  • Drive full-funnel commerce strategies for planning and activating programmatic campaigns, collaborating with retail search teams for seamless integration.
  • Utilize Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) to activate custom audiences and implement advanced programmatic strategies.
  • Manage regular client communications to review programmatic performance, discuss business trends, and identify growth opportunities across channels.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve client business performance through innovative, data-driven solutions.
  • Lead programmatic updates during integrated reporting sessions, such as QBRs and annual planning meetings.
  • Guide account strategy development, including budget planning, KPI setting, audience testing, and industry trend analysis.
  • Drive new business development and client expansion opportunities.
  • Leverage reporting, analytics, and competitive analysis tools to refine strategies and achieve measurable results.
  • Contribute to the success of small- and medium-sized client businesses by delivering innovative programmatic solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Provide feedback on product development and user experience based on insights gathered from client interactions and campaign performance.

  • Fully remote work
  • The opportunity to join an international team
  • Generous Paid Time Off

Your Purpose

The Accounts Payable Specialist, who will be part of the Finance division, will be responsible for the administration and recording of expenses (overhead, employee expenses, reimbursements, and credit card reconciliation) as well as the administration of supplier master data.

Reports To

Accounts Payable Lead

  • At least 3 years of experience in accounts payable in Brazil.
  • Proven expertise in processing and performing the accounting registration for local payment methods, including Boleto Bancário and PIX.
  • Experience with other Latin American countries is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian tax requirements applicable to bill payments, including knowledge of withholding taxes (e.g., IRRF, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Experience with NetSuite and/or other ERP systems.
  • Degree in Accounting, Business Management, or a related field.
  • Strong aptitude for numbers and computations.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy is a must.
  • Organized and proactive, with the ability to take initiative and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • An agile and efficient work ethic with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, in both verbal and written form (English).
  • A strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the company's core values.
  • Service-oriented attitude.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information.

What You Will Do

  • Ensure all accounts payable policies and procedures are adhered to including travel and related expenses, mainly in Brazil and Latin American entities.
  • Improve and continue accounts payable policies.
  • Maintain accounts payable files.
  • Review of tax requirements.
  • Weekly payments schedule.
  • Prepares journal entries; maintains and reconciles ledger accounts.
  • Ensure all reporting is completed accurately and timely, including month-end closing, audits, and other requests.
  • Maintaining constant and strong communication with the treasury and planning teams to ensure the veracity of accounting and financial information.
  • Working hand in hand with the company’s Treasurer to report weekly and monthly the expenses detailed by the cost center and tribes.
  • Reconciliation and integration of accounts payable balances (by name and age).
  • Credit card reconciliation (by name and age).
  • Assist with audits by providing supporting records and documentation.

At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven : We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency : We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills : We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management : We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

Benefits

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

title: Product Designer Brazil - Remote (any location) $48k - $66k
description:
About Us

Want to work on tackling climate change? We are SINAI , a San Francisco-based technology startup focused on transforming the way companies price, analyze, and reduce carbon emissions around the world. We are passionate about technology and the environment.

We are seeking a Mid-Level Product Designer to join our product and design team. You’ll play a key role in shaping the user experience and interface of our products, working closely with cross-functional teams to bring your designs to life. Your work will directly help our customers achieve their decarbonization goals.

Our mission is to enable companies to meet their carbon reduction targets in the most efficient way possible, transforming the way they interact with their own business, their value chain, and the environment.

We value building an inclusive and mindful environment made up of people who take ownership while being respectful, proactive, and data-driven. We are looking to hire a Product Designer who has experience designing and shipping modern UX, can make tradeoffs while delivering high-value outcomes, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

About the Role

As a Mid-Level Product Designer at SINAI, you’ll focus on collaborating with your product and engineering team to review design briefs and brainstorm solutions. You’ll refine wireframes and prototypes, run quick usability tests, and gather feedback from stakeholders. Weekly design reviews will be a regular part of your routine, where you’ll present your work and gain valuable insights.

In this fast-paced, dynamic environment, you’ll balance creative design with strategic thinking, helping shape products that enable our customers to achieve their decarbonization goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design Autonomy: Lead the end-to-end design process, from receiving the pitch to implementation, ensuring high-quality, user-centered designs.
  • Team Participation: Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define features within the problem pitch, designing solutions in defined cycles.
  • User Research: Conduct user research in Portuguese and English to deeply understand user needs and inform design decisions.
  • UI/UX Design: Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for web applications, ensuring a seamless user experience for different personas.
  • Data driven: Familiarity with analytics, basic understanding of data synthesis and methodologies.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with an agile team and subject matter experts, contributing to brainstorming sessions and shaping the overall product vision.
  • Iteration & Improvement: Continuously iterate on designs based on feedback and testing to align with user needs and company goals.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years as a Product Designer with a strong portfolio in web and SaaS applications; fluency in English and prior experience with remote and high growth startups within Brazil are a must; prior experience with U.S. company and climate tech are a plus but not required
  • User-Centered Design: Expertise in UX/UI design with a focus on intuitive, user-friendly interfaces.
  • Tools: Proficiency in Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar tools; experience with analytics platforms such as Amplitude desired.
  • Collaboration: Strong communication skills for effective cross-functional teamwork.
  • Agility: Ability to adapt in a fast-paced startup environment and is proactive about taking on various roles as needed.
  • Passion: A genuine interest in climate tech and sustainability, with a desire to contribute to meaningful work.

Salary $48,000 - $66,000 USD

The offered salary or salary range is based on several factors, including, but not limited to, overall experience, relevant experience, education level, certifications, applicable skills and expertise, and location of the position.

Join us in driving innovation and making a difference in the fight against climate change!
